title: Neural Implicit Energy Optimization for LiDAR Mapping
abstract: arXiv:2610.28598v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural implicit representations provide memory-efficient signed distance field (SDF) parameterizations for large-scale LiDAR scenes, but the geometry recovered from sparse and often noisy inputs carries jitter and artifacts. Classical geometric optimization techniques resolve such artifacts with surface energy functionals, whose minimizers correspond to smooth surfaces. Motivated by this principle, we formulate neural LiDAR mapping as the optimization of energy functionals over the parameter space of neural implicit representations. Specifically, we regularize the signed distance field with an energy functional defined on the shape operator of its level set, which represents the curvature of the surface, thus encouraging smoothness along the surface. translated_title: 基于神经隐式能量优化的激光雷达建图
translated_abstract: 神经隐式表示为大规模激光雷达场景提供了内存高效的符号距离场（SDF）参数化，但从稀疏且常带噪声的输入中恢复的几何体存在抖动和伪影。经典的几何优化技术通过表面能量泛函来解决此类伪影，其极小值对应于光滑表面。受此原理启发，我们将神经激光雷达建图表述为在神经隐式表示参数空间上的能量泛函优化。具体而言，我们使用定义在符号距离场水平集形状算子上的能量泛函对其进行正则化，该算子表示表面的曲率，从而促进沿表面的平滑性。这将经典几何先验适配到百万点级激光雷达地图的规模。在大规模数据集上的实验表明，重建结果在保持几何保真度的同时具有更好的平滑性。
tldr: 该论文将神经激光雷达建图表述为神经隐式表示参数空间上的能量泛函优化，通过基于水平集形状算子（曲率）的能量泛函正则化符号距离场，将经典几何先验适配到百万点级大规模场景，在保持几何保真度的同时实现更平滑的重建。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates neural LiDAR mapping as energy functional optimization over the parameter space of neural implicit representations, regularizing the SDF with a curvature-based energy functional defined on the shape operator of its level set, thereby adapting classical geometric priors to million-point scale LiDAR maps and achieving smoother reconstructions while preserving geometric fidelity.
